# 3D Deep-Sim Studio Engine & Harness Compact API Sheet (`studio/llms.txt`)
#
# Borrowed from the VibeGame `llms.txt` pattern: Agents MUST read this compact
# API sheet instead of scanning full engine/harness source files.

## 1. Studio Harness CLI Commands
- `node harness/agents.mjs [list | show <id> | create <id> <Title> | json]`
  Loads all roles from `studio/roles/**/*.md` (5 default + unlimited custom roles/swarms) and presets from `studio/presets/*.md`.
- `node harness/route.mjs [--role <id>] [--prompt "..."] [--dry-run] [--status]`
  Executes `freecc:auto` multi-model failover routing across Vertex Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, Groq, OpenRouter, xAI Grok, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama with 30s+ cooldowns in `.studio/cooldowns.json`.
- `node harness/task.mjs [next | list | start <ID> | done <ID> [--force] | add "<Title>" --role <role> --priority P0..P3 [--type bug|study|balance|fun|playtest|review|docs]]`
  Manages `studio/NEXT.md` and synchronizes `studio/CURRENT_TASK.md`. `done` refuses until the task's done-check passes.
- `npm run handoff` · `node harness/handoff.mjs note "<what, why, next>"`
  The Producer's briefing from files (plan, log, decisions, queue, claims, gates, bugs, sign-offs, meetings). `studio/MASTER.md` maps the key documents.
- `node harness/meeting.mjs start "<topic>" --with a,b | say "<text>" --agent <name> | end [--decision "..."] [--action "title|role|P2"] | status`
  A Producer meeting with several agents. Notes in `studio/meetings/`, actions become tasks.
- `node harness/done-check.mjs <ID>`
  Shows a task's type, what done means for it, and what is missing. One skill per type in `studio/skills/`.
- `node harness/plugins.mjs [list | enable <id> | disable <id> | mcp]`
  Outside tools agents can use (`studio/plugins.json`): REA, Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, Blender, Godot, Unity.
- `node harness/event.mjs --type <event.type> --agent <role> [--task <ID>] [--to producer] --msg "<summary>"`
  Appends a zero-token telemetry line to `.studio/events.jsonl` (mirror only if AGENT_EVENTS_MIRROR is set).
- `node harness/status.mjs [--json]`
  Prints a 0-token studio snapshot combining queue, router matrix, and recent events.
- `node hub/server.mjs`
  Starts the Zero-Token Passive Workflow UI HUB (`http://127.0.0.1:3847/?token=<HUB_TOKEN>`; `?view=mobile` for phones).
- `node qa/playtest.mjs [--stage 1|2] [--cartridge name] [--scenario name] [--seed 1337] [--ticks N] [--url http://127.0.0.1:5173/?playtest=1]`
  Runs Stage 1 programmatic trajectory QA + Stage 2 Playwright accessibility/UISentinel layout QA and writes reports to `qa/reports/`.
- `node scripts/check-sim-purity.mjs`
  Static scan + runtime traps: no DOM, renderers, randomness, clock or timers in `src/sim/` or `cartridges/`.

## 2. Simulation Cartridge Contract (`cartridges/README.md`, loaded by `harness/cartridge.mjs`)
`cartridges/<name>/index.mjs`:
- `createInitialState(seed, tuning?)` — plain JSON state; seeded Mulberry32 RNG state lives inside it.
- `step(state, actions|null)` — one fixed tick, returns a new state; `actions` is an array.
- `invariants(state)` — `[{ id, severity: 'P0'|'P1'|'P2', summary }]` (NaN/Infinity check added by the harness).
- `outcome(state)` — `'won' | 'lost' | null`. `TUNING` — every balance number in one table.
- `hashState(state)` optional — default is the 64-bit hash in `harness/hash.mjs` (= `tools/golden.py`).
`cartridges/<name>/qa.mjs`: `scenarios['start-to-win'] = { seed, maxTicks, policy(state, tick), expect: 'won' }`.

## 3. Everyday commands
- `npm run new-game <name>` · `npm run verify` · `npm run release`
- `node qa/playtest.mjs --stage 1 [--cartridge name] [--scenario start-to-win]` — stops on the first failing tick
- `node harness/replay.mjs --trace .studio/last-seed-failure.json` — reproduce a closed-loop failure
- `npm run golden -- --update` — after an intended sim change; commit hashes with the change
- `npm run balance` / `npm run fun` — sweep `TUNING` (studio/balance/sweep.json) / fun proxies
- `node harness/lock.mjs claim path:<dir> --owner <unique>` · `node harness/task.mjs start <ID> --agent <unique>`
